Mock tests and practice are not the same layer

Practice sets are lighter and better for repeated topic drilling. Mock tests are stronger when you want more complete paper pressure.

If your subject route is still unclear, you usually need subject choice and practice first, not a full paid mock pack.

If your route is already clear, mock tests become useful when your next problem is timing, stability, and exam rhythm rather than basic topic discovery.

Start with practice

Use practice sets if you still need lower-pressure repetition before you can benefit from a full timed paper.

Move into mock tests

Use mock tests once the subject is confirmed in your route and you need to pressure-test pace and consistency.

Buy full packs last

Treat the full pack as the final step after route clarity and sample exposure, not as the first decision.
